exclusionRules: All instructor CSV rows retained; no additional duration, usertype, station, or deduplication filtering.
timestampPolicy: Preserve starttime local civil-date prefix without browser/UTC timezone conversion. Source timestamps carry no UTC offset; the file does not independently prove a timezone offset.
coverage: Monthly JC April 2020 file; every one of 30 April dates has positive records. No date has been zero-filled. Completeness beyond the publisher release is not independently established.
originalWebsiteComparison: Instructor supplied the project CSV and source. This CSV matches the official monthly release in every parsed record; only the final newline differs. The native classroom app is an explicit two-chapter reconstruction.

officialCrossCheck.difference: Instructor CSV omits the final newline in the official CSV; all other bytes and all parsed records are identical.

independentAggregateCheck.method: SQLite GROUP BY substr(starttime,1,10), COUNT(*) on the instructor CSV
independentAggregateCheck.result: All 30 date/count pairs match the Python-derived daily.json exactly
